function: Over-the-air aggregation of federated model updates with retransmission-based AirComp, designed jointly with digital data upload, CPU frequencies and data allocation ratios (pp. 3-4).
system: K=10 single-antenna devices, BS with Nr=16 antennas, no RIS; AirComp model uplink plus orthogonal digital data uplink; bandwidth 0.5 MHz, carrier frequency not stated (p. 11).
method: 16-layer CNN and 102-layer ResNet trained with semi-federated learning (FL at devices plus centralized learning at the BS); SCA optimizes the resources (pp. 4, 11).
data_channel: Simulated quasi-static Rayleigh fading with path loss c0*d^-2.6, devices in a 40-50 m ring; CIFAR-10, Fashion-MNIST, MNIST as learning data (pp. 5, 11).
test_conditions: Same simulated setup for training and testing; sweeps of radius, bandwidth, alpha and MSE threshold are separate runs; no unseen scenario, dataset or adaptation (pp. 11-15).
baselines: No-retransmission one-shot baseline, SemiFL with random data upload, FL, CL; earlier schemes SemiFL [8], SemiFL [9], HFCL [10], AirReComp [26] (pp. 11-13).
metrics: Test classification accuracy, cumulative weighted latency-energy objective, cumulative latency, cumulative energy, model-uploading latency and energy (pp. 12-15).
complexity: Worst-case order O((3^3+L1)N1N2+(K+2)^3N2+4^3N2+3^3N2) for Algorithm 2 with interior-point CVX solves; no runtime or FLOPs reported (p. 10).
openness: none stated for code or data; ref. [44] https://github.com/zhengjh721/ZJH_Retransmission_SemiFL is described only as supplementary material with a proof (p. 17).
q1_support: p. 5: "Rayleigh channel coefficient vector from the k-th device to". Custom Rayleigh model with path loss c0*d^-2.6 (p. 11); no 3GPP model, DeepMIMO or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 11: "consisting of K = 10 single-antenna devices and a BS". One configuration (K=10, Nr=16, T=200); Figs. 4-9 only sweep alpha, radius, bandwidth, MSE threshold; no unseen scenario, dataset or fine-tuning.
q3_support: p. 13: "Despite AirReComp in [26] employing retransmission for AirComp-based". Earlier aggregation design [26] and schemes [8], [9], [10] compared on accuracy (Fig. 5); no-retransmission one-shot baseline and random-upload SemiFL-RDU are the simple non-learned ones (pp. 11, 13).
q4_support: p. 10: "worst-case complexity of Algorithm 2 is given by" O((3^3+L1)N1N2+(K+2)^3N2+4^3N2+3^3N2) for the aggregation and resource design.
q5_support: p. 17: "[44] J. Zheng et al. (Dec. 2023). Supplementary Material for the Paper:" GitHub link used only for the proof of Theorem 1 (p. 7); data are CIFAR-10, Fashion-MNIST, MNIST (p. 11), public sets of the learning task only; no code or channel data release stated.
notes: Included as area 7: the model uploading uses retransmission-based AirComp (p. 3), so the learned element is the model trained across devices (rule 3). Joint optimization of CPU frequencies and data ratios is above the physical layer, but the aggregation itself is over the air. q3 is a judgment: all baselines train a model, so the non-learned ones are the simple no-retransmission and random-upload baselines; reviewer to confirm. q5: the GitHub repository in ref.
